steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the name and package of Simple Counter inside app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Establish build settings with Gradle 8.5, Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2, and Target SDK 34.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml declaring package namespace, app icon references, and standard material themes.

steps.title: Design Core Counter Layout
steps.description: Create the main activity UI structure using standard Android layouts like ScrollView, LinearLayout, TextView, and Buttons.

steps.title: Establish MainActivity Package Structure
steps.description: Initialize the Java class structure for com.simplecounter.app.MainActivity.

steps.title: Initialize UI Widgets & Lifecycle
steps.description: Bind layout components like TextViews and Buttons dynamically inside MainActivity's onCreate method.

steps.title: Implement State Restoration
steps.description: Utilize SharedPreferences to restore previous counter values, note states, and custom step settings on startup.

steps.title: Develop Counter Logic
steps.description: Write event listeners for the decrement and increment buttons using strictly Java 8 compatible anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Implement Variable Step Increments
steps.description: Create logic to toggle and cycle through different jump levels (1, 5, 10, 50, 100) on counter buttons.

steps.title: Set Up Persistent Autosave
steps.description: Save state data inside onPause to prevent losing counter info during configuration changes or background context switches.

steps.title: Building Simple Counter
steps.description: Execute final build verification tasks and package the debug application APK.
